ease.reason: A synthetic trigger and message can be mapped, but no supplied implementation reference supports the provider setup.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small professional-services operator may pay for routine email setup; one request gives no payment evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (23/5 = 4.6). A synthetic trigger-to-email mock is imaginable, but no supplied building reference supports provider setup or delivery; the exact request was previously assessed without new supporting evidence.

steps.message: Assessed all eight sealed discussion identities. No publishable idea: the concrete email request is below threshold, and the concrete restock workflow overlaps the recent online-shop support workflow and customer.
